title: No herbal medicine at game start
recommendation: Harvest wild healroot on Day 1-2; plant healroot growing zone (Growing 8+); build drug lab for medicine crafting.
rationale: Session 1: colonists died from injuries no one could treat (no medicine).

title: No medical bed early
recommendation: Build 1-2 beds designated as medical early; assign doctor work type to best medicine pawn.
rationale: Session 1 and 3: downed colonists could not heal without a medical bed.

title: Ignoring animal threats
recommendation: Check wildlife tab for predators; draft colonists if dangerous animals near; build walls around growing zones and work areas. Do not hunt predators.
rationale: Session 1: guinea pig killed Vlad. Session 2: timber wolf killed Shin while hunting.

title: Not burying corpses
recommendation: Designate dumping stockpile for corpses or butcher them; set hauling priority high for corpse removal.
rationale: Unburied colonist corpse causes a 'left unburied' thought after 4 game days (wiki: Thoughts).

title: Mood spiral after lover death
recommendation: Monitor colonist relationships; watch for grief debuffs; have recreation and food ready during crises.
rationale: Session 1: Roni mental break after Vlad died; mood dropped to 14%.

title: Hunter killed by predator
recommendation: Do not hunt predators. Check wildlife tab for predators near hunting ground. Never hunt alone at map edge. Draft a fighter escort.
rationale: Session 2 Day 5: Shin mauled by timber wolf while hunting deer herd. Time advanced at Superfast hid the attack.

title: No freezer early
recommendation: Build 7x7 freezer room by Day 4-7, set cooler to -5C. Place near kitchen for short hauling routes.
rationale: Session 2: food rotted, colonists ate raw food, mood crashed.

title: Eating without table
recommendation: Place table + chairs in shelter on Day 1.
rationale: Eating without a table gives a mood debuff.

title: Sleeping outside or cold
recommendation: Build enclosed shelter with roof before nightfall.
rationale: Multiple mood debuffs from sleeping outside or in cold.

title: No recreation variety
recommendation: Build horseshoe pin Day 1; add chess table and TV later. 2-6 recreation types needed depending on wealth expectations (wiki: Wealth).
rationale: Mood stagnates without recreation variety. Tolerance builds with repetition (wiki: Recreation).

title: Cooking in dirty area
recommendation: Separate kitchen from workshop; floor the kitchen. Cleanliness affects food poisoning chance (wiki: Blood_loss, Bedroom).
rationale: Session 2: Peachy got food poisoning from dirty outdoor cooking area, mood crashed to 20%.

title: Small stockpile jams colony
recommendation: Make stockpiles large (49+ cells). Small zones fill to 100% and idle the whole colony.
rationale: Session 2: 6-cell stockpile hit 100% full, entire colony went idle.

title: Time control: never bare-unpause
recommendation: Always use wait_for_event with maxGameHours + pause='always'. Bare unpause at Superfast hides events and kills colonists.
rationale: Session 2: bare unpause at Superfast hid wolf kill + raid. Shin died. Session 3: sparrow attack unobserved.

title: Hunting at map edge solo
recommendation: Never hunt alone at map edge. Draft a fighter escort. Pause and watch when a hunt starts.
rationale: Session 2: Shin mauled by timber wolf at far map edge, no one near to tend her.

title: Wildlife can break into base
recommendation: Watch DangerRating and threat warnings. Wildlife can enter the base.
rationale: Session 3: wild sparrow downed 2 colonists inside base. DangerRating High.

title: Food runs low by Day 6-7
recommendation: Plant 40-60 tiles of rice on Day 1. Cook simple meals steadily. Keep 2+ weeks of food. This lesson is about GROWING enough crops. If the crops are already in the field but food days are still falling, the problem is L-0052 (plant cutting priority too low), not planting volume - check the plant cutting work priority before adding fields.
rationale: Session 4 and 5: low food alert by Day 8/Day 6. Rice harvest started late. run-007: this lesson was retrieved on 7 of 14 advice days and the colony still starved - but the cause was plant cutting priority, not too few crops, so the lesson did not apply. Scope it to planting volume only; L-0052 covers the processing step.

title: Construction not prioritized
recommendation: Assign Construction priority 1 to a capable pawn early. Verify blueprints actually get built. Don't let walls stall.
rationale: Session 4: 13 wall blueprints sat unbuilt for 3+ days. 'Need defenses' alert persisted Days 3-6.

title: Research bench placement
recommendation: Place research bench indoors with light. Cleanliness affects research speed (wiki: Bedroom, Research).
rationale: Session 3 and 4: 'Need research project' alert. Bench outside room airspace.

title: Medical treatment without medical bed
recommendation: Set a bed to medical early. Keep doctor assigned and medicine stocked. Injuries happen even on easy.
rationale: Session 4 Day 6: 'Medical treatment needed' despite 30 medicine. Session 5: Tyren wounded in raid, healed via medical bed.

title: Shared barracks mood penalty
recommendation: Build individual bedrooms (3x3+) early. Dull barracks -5, awful barracks -7 mood (wiki: Thoughts, Bedroom).
rationale: Session 5: moods 40-77 in shared barracks. Horseshoes pin helped +5-10.

title: Social friction: Henry (misogynist) + Chaz (female)
recommendation: Monitor social traits. Misogynist pawns may cause friction with female colonists. Separate or manage.
rationale: Session 5: Henry's mood 48-57, Chaz 51-68. Social friction observed.

title: Sandbags need cloth or Fabric/Leathery
recommendation: Build sandbags from Fabric or Leathery material (not cloth only) per the wiki; plant cotton on Day 1 if cloth is needed. Re-test material acceptance in-game if the MCP tool rejects non-cloth. Have sandbags ready before the first raid (~Day 5).
rationale: Wiki (Sandbags) confirms Fabric or Leathery material, 5 units, 55% cover. The MCP tool only accepted cloth in Session 5, but the wiki is authoritative.

title: Do not pack everything into one room
recommendation: Separate room roles: bedroom (bed), dining (table+chairs), kitchen (stove), workshop (benches), hospital (medical beds), laboratory (research bench), rec room (horseshoes/TV). A room can serve multiple roles but mixing kitchen/workshop with living spaces causes problems.
rationale: Session 6: packed everything into 7x7, research bench conflicts with bed interaction spots, 'Need research bench' alert.

title: Tyren (psychopath) in melee
recommendation: Keep fighters at range. Use melee only as last resort. Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts but still feel pain.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren took knife wounds (80 HP) in close combat during raid.

title: First raid can come early
recommendation: Have weapons + sandbags ready by Day 5. Vanilla RimWorld enforces an early grace period, then the first threat/raid typically arrives around Day 5 (~15:00 under Cassandra Classic); Phoebe Chillax is similar but slower; Randy Random has no fixed schedule and may strike on Day 1. Do not assume a Days 8-15 window.
rationale: Session 5: raid on Day 5 (Pollution Unit, 1 raider) under Phoebe Chillax. Vanilla mechanics: first major threat/raid arrives around Day 5 after the early grace period; Cassandra Classic ~Day 5 15:00, Phoebe similar but more spaced, Randy Random unpredictable.

title: Research set to Smithing first
recommendation: Smithing (700) is the gateway to weapons and armor. Set it on Day 1.
rationale: Session 5: Smithing completed Day 5, set Batteries next.

title: Idle colonist needs secondary work
recommendation: Give idle colonists secondary work (haul, clean, construct). Chaz idled when research bench occupied.
rationale: Session 5: '1 colonist idle' alert. Chaz wandered when research bench was occupied.

title: Tyren (psychopath) mood management
recommendation: Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts. Use recreation (horseshoes) and good food to compensate. Mood 40-77 observed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren mood 40-77. Horseshoes pin helped. Medical bed set for healing.

title: Naming dialog (faction/settlement)
recommendation: The naming dialog appears repeatedly. Close with window_action close or set text and accept.
rationale: Session 5: Dialog_NamePlayerFactionAndSettlement appeared multiple times.

title: Wait is already in progress
recommendation: wait_for_event can get stuck. Use real-time sleep (time.sleep) as fallback. Check game state after.
rationale: Session 5 and 6: 'A wait is already in progress' error from stuck wait_for_event.

title: Research bench conflicts with bed placement
recommendation: Research bench interaction spots conflict with bed placement. Plan interior layout carefully or place bench outside.
rationale: Session 6: bench placed outside due to interaction spot conflict with beds.

title: Cotton for cloth/sandbags
recommendation: Plant cotton early for cloth. Sandbags need cloth (MCP) or Fabric/Leathery (wiki).
rationale: Session 5: 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days — no cloth for sandbags.

title: Rice field sowing takes time
recommendation: Start sowing rice on Day 1. 197-cell field took 5-6 days to sow. Harvest started Day 6.
rationale: Session 5: rice harvest began Day 6. Low food alert Day 6-7.

title: Henry (misogynist) + Chaz (female) social friction
recommendation: Misogynist pawns cause social friction with female colonists. Monitor mood or separate.
rationale: Session 5: Henry mood 48-57, Chaz 51-68. Social friction observed.

title: Medical bed helps healing
recommendation: Set a bed to medical early. Tyren healed from 80 to 100 HP using medical bed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren wounded in raid (80 HP), healed to 100 via medical bed.

title: First raid can come early (Day 5)
recommendation: Have weapons + defenses ready by Day 5. First raid window is not fixed at Days 8-15.
rationale: Session 5: raid on Day 5 (Pollution Unit, 1 raider). 'Need defenses' alert persisted 7 days.

title: Tyren (psychopath) mood management
recommendation: Psychopaths don't get social mood boosts. Use recreation (horseshoes) and good food to compensate. Mood 40-77 observed.
rationale: Session 5: Tyren mood 40-77. Horseshoes pin helped. Medical bed set for healing.

title: Naming dialog (faction/settlement)
recommendation: The naming dialog appears repeatedly. Close with window_action close or set text and accept.
rationale: Session 5: Dialog_NamePlayerFactionAndSettlement appeared multiple times.

title: Research-complete dialog silently stops time
recommendation: When wait_for_event returns ticksWaited 0 and the hour never changes, call list_windows. A Dialog_NodeTree such as 'Research finished: ...' has forcePause true; close it with window_action(option=OK) before waiting again.
rationale: run-002: research completion dialogs stalled time for minutes; the monitor and the agent both saw 'no progress' until the dialog was closed.

title: Smithing is a separate work type from Crafting
recommendation: To make weapons or smithy apparel, enable Smithing on a colonist (Crafting alone does nothing for the smithy). Smithing 1-2 is enough to get the bill started.
rationale: run-002: a longsword bill sat untouched for hours with a colonist at Crafting 1; setting Smithing 1 started it immediately.

title: Forever cook bills starve smithing and building
recommendation: Set cooking bills to a target count (10-12 meals) rather than 'forever', so the cook returns to other work when the stock is full.
rationale: run-002: a forever CookMealSimple bill kept Niklas at the stove for a whole day while the longsword bill had a colonist and 100 steel waiting.

title: Ground food is invisible to get_resource_readout
recommendation: Before declaring a food emergency, count harvest on the ground with list_things (defName RawRice/RawBerries) and check that a stockpile has free cells and Hauling is enabled. The readout only counts stored items.
rationale: run-002: 34 rice stacks (~200 rice) sat in the field uncounted because the kitchen stockpile (5 cells) was full; the readout showed 24 rice and the colony looked starving.

title: New colonists need an allowed area
recommendation: After a quest colonist joins (or a wanderer), restrict them to the colony allowed area until they have a bed and a weapon. They wander far, get chased by predators and get downed.
rationale: run-002: the Hunted Knight's colonist walked to a river ~100 cells away, was chased by a manhunter rat, got downed at (249,51) and had to be saved by two drafted colonists.

title: Check recipe material costs before promising the item
recommendation: Longsword needs 100 steel (not 50). Confirm stock or mine compacted steel (40 per tile) before adding the bill; the bill will sit idle saying 'Missing 100x metal or wood'.
rationale: run-002: 95 steel in stock blocked the longsword bill until 3 compacted steel tiles were mined next to the workshop.

title: Vanilla research cannot be queued: the next project is a hand decision
recommendation: Do not plan a multi-project queue; it does not exist. Pick the next project in advance so it can be set the instant the current one completes, and treat the 'Need research project' alert as lost research hours.
rationale: run-002: 'Need research project' appeared on 12th Aprimay after many completed projects. The player confirmed a project cannot be queued in vanilla, so the gap is a decision-timing problem, not a forgotten click.

title: A protection-quest target is an escorted liability, not a colonist to integrate
recommendation: For 'protect X' quests: restrict the target's allowed area to the base, give them food they accept and a weapon if they can fight, and when the extraction vehicle lands, order them to board it explicitly. The quest does not complete on its own.
rationale: run-002: the Hunted Knight (Antigonos Baspho) arrived at 18% mood, hit 14%, was downed once, and left only after being ordered into the shuttle; that order ended the quest in success.

title: Restrict a temporary pawn's allowed area on the day they arrive
recommendation: Put quest guests, visitors and prisoners in an allowed area covering the base and freezer only. They wander to satisfy their own needs and get downed outside the defensive line, where rescuing them costs the colony a firefight.
rationale: run-002: the quest guest walked roughly 100 cells to a river and was downed by a manhunter rat; Matthew and Toni had to leave the base to recover him.

title: Fire during a raid is usually enemy action, not a construction accident
recommendation: When fire starts during a raid, assume arson: name one firefighter, keep the rest on the fighting line, and treat the burning room as part of the battle. Do not wait for the raid to end before putting it out.
rationale: run-002: the 12th Aprimay fire coincided with the raiders and the player confirmed a raider lit it. Eight of the run's twelve urgent records came from that single fire-plus-raid incident.

title: Construction backlog: walls and conduits left unbuilt
recommendation: Prioritize Construction work for the builder and keep materials (wood/steel) stocked near blueprints. Check reachability; unbuilt walls and conduits leave defenses and power incomplete.
rationale: run-004 observe: 11 wall and 3 hidden conduit sites sat unbuilt for 3+ days despite a capable builder.

title: Research bench missing when project requires it
recommendation: Build a simple research bench before selecting projects that require one (e.g. batteries). Place it indoors with light.
rationale: run-004: active project battery (cost 400) could not progress because no research bench existed.

title: Thin food buffer at end of run
recommendation: Maintain more than 3 days of food. Expand potato or rice fields and build a freezer by mid-run; harvest and cook steadily.
rationale: run-004 ended with Low food alert (1 day) despite 84 potatoes; wealth and population stable.

title: Plant cutting priority too low: harvest not processed into meals
recommendation: Assign the Plant Cutting work type priority 1-2 on a colonist from Day 1, and check that harvested crops are actually being hauled to the kitchen and cooked. A harvest in the field is not food: without plant cutting and hauling, raw crops stay in the field and food days keep falling even when a harvest lands. Keep the cooking bill on a target count (10-12 meals), not 'forever', so the cook returns to the fields. Verify with the food-days readout, not the raw resource count.
rationale: run-007-adv-cassandra: the colony ended in Starvation with 2.2 days of food and Steven Wilcox's mood at 17% (major break risk). Food days decayed from 7.2 (Day 1) to 3.5 (Day 3) to 1.5 (Day 10) even though a rice harvest landed on 1st of Jugust and the food count jumped from 15 to 205 units, which was consumed within a single day. The player confirmed the cause: plant-cutting work was not assigned a high enough priority, so harvested crops were never processed into meals. This is a different failure from L-0016 (too few crops planted): here the crops existed and were not converted into food. L-0016 was retrieved on 7 of 14 advice days during this run and the colony still starved, so planting volume alone is not the lever.
source: Day 10: rice harvest, food stock 15 -> 205 units

title: Reflex systems critical for early raids under Cassandra Classic
recommendation: Enable reflex/advisor systems for Cassandra Classic Adventure story to handle brutal early raids
rationale: current-run survived massive early raid with mood hitting 1% due to 85 reflex interventions

title: Food security remains precarious even with reflex management
recommendation: Maintain food reserves above 5 days; prioritize food production before other projects
rationale: current-run had low food from Septober 7 and ended at 0.8 days despite reflex interventions

title: Medicine stockpiles essential for injury management
recommendation: Stockpile medicine early; cultivate healroot and complete medicine production research
rationale: current-run repeatedly ran out of medicine, ended with only 5 despite injuries

title: Early raid + extreme mood collapse on Day 3 requires immediate defensive posture under Cassandra Adventure Story
recommendation: By the end of day 2 construct at least one sandbag line or simple choke point and station armed colonists. Treat the first raid as inevitable rather than a surprise.
rationale: Incident snapshots on 3rd of Aprimay show repeated 'Raid: enemies' concurrent with extreme break risk (mood 1%). Adventure Story threat scale is 60% and base mood is only 37%, leaving almost no buffer. Sandbags provide 55% cover from fabric or leathery materials and are the fastest early defensive option.
source: 3rd of Aprimay raid snapshots and urgent advice

title: Chronic food insecurity from day 6 onward is the dominant long-term risk
recommendation: Plant rice or potatoes from day 1 in parallel with hunting. Maintain a hard floor of 3–4 days of cooked meals. Never rely solely on packaged survival meals past day 4.
rationale: Food alerts and stock swings are the most consistent leading indicator across the entire timeline. On Adventure Story the low base mood means hunger debuffs rapidly push colonists toward minor (35%) and major (20%) break thresholds.

title: Prolonged downed colonist without dedicated medical focus creates multi-day crisis
recommendation: Assign a dedicated doctor the moment any colonist is downed. Keep a hard floor of 15 medicine. Pause non-critical work until the patient is stable.
rationale: A single long-term patient removes a worker and generates continuous negative mood pressure. Combined with Adventure Story's low base mood, this rapidly escalates into major and extreme break risk for the rest of the colony.

title: Royalty infrastructure must be built before accepting or progressing novice titles
recommendation: As soon as the first Empire or Refugee Empire title quest appears, construct a proper meditation throne and designated meditation spot before accepting further bestowing ceremonies.
rationale: Persistent infrastructure alerts coincide with active novice ceremony quests. Without the required facilities the colony cannot convert honor into useful psylink levels and instead carries permanent quality-of-life penalties.
source: 3rd of Jugust onward (Throne not usable, Need meditation spot)

title: Medicine and food floors must be raised before accepting multi-day hospitality or worker-loan quests
recommendation: Before accepting any multi-day hospitality or worker-loan quest, verify food buffer ≥3 days and medicine ≥15. Decline or delay quests that would push either resource below those floors.
rationale: Temporary population increases without matching production amplify both starvation and medical risk, especially after earlier injury waves. The final recorded state confirms the colony finished critically short on both resources.

title: Chronic food shortfall from early underproduction and delayed cooking/planting
cause_chain: Low food alert appears by 4th of Aprimay and remains almost continuous
Early reliance on foraging, small meat hauls, and packaged survival meals with minimal sustained planting or cooking capacity
Food stock repeatedly drops to critical levels while colonists continue non-food work (stone cutting, wall building)
By 3rd of Jugust only 0.8 days of food remain alongside major mood and medical crises
recommendation: Prioritize a small rice or berry plot and a dedicated cook schedule by day 3–4; keep at least 2–3 days of cooked meals before expanding stone or construction projects.
rationale: Wiki confirms rice matures in ~5.54 days yielding 6 units per plant. Persistent Low food alerts from day 4 onward, combined with end-state 0.8 days of food, show production never caught demand. Mood and medical emergencies compound when food is also low.

title: Shadow's mood collapse into major break risk and downing under cumulative stressors
cause_chain: Shadow's mood drops from mid-50s into the teens by 2nd–3rd of Jugust
Major break risk alerts fire repeatedly while he continues heavy labor (digging, stone work)
No beds, no meditation spot, low food, ongoing medical needs, and Empire quest expectations stack
He is eventually downed while still at ~30% mood
recommendation: When a colonist is designated for Empire titles or psylink, immediately create a private bedroom, recreation, and a meditation spot; reduce their labor priority the moment mood approaches 35%.
rationale: Wiki: normal minor break threshold 35%, major 20%. Shadow repeatedly sits at 13–19% (major break risk) with advice entries marked failed/open. End metadata records lowest mood 15%. The downing occurs while medical emergency and Low food are active.

title: Insufficient medical capacity and beds after early combat injuries
cause_chain: Mariya and Robert take significant injuries on 6th–7th of Aprimay during combat with Agent
Medical treatment needed and Low medicine alerts persist for the rest of the run
Need colonist beds alert reappears; Shadow later downs with medical emergency active
recommendation: After any combat that drops a colonist below ~60% health, pause expansion, build at least one proper bed per colonist, and stockpile or produce herbal medicine before resuming construction.
rationale: Injuries are recorded on 6th/7th of Aprimay and again later. Low medicine and Medical treatment needed alerts never clear. Wiki notes herbal medicine from healroot and industrial medicine requiring research + components. End-state has only 3 medicine.
source: 3rd of Jugust medical emergency + Shadow DOWNED

title: Empire/psycaster quest chain accepted without supporting infrastructure
cause_chain: Shadow accepts and completes Shadow's Novice Ceremony
Need meditation spot and Practitioner role unfilled alerts appear immediately after
Bestower and ceremony events occur while Low food, Low medicine, and Fire! are active
No throneroom or dedicated meditation area is ever recorded as built
recommendation: Before accepting any Empire bestowing or psylink ceremony, construct the required meditation spot and at least a minimal private room; reject or delay the quest if the colony is still under Low food / Low medicine pressure.
rationale: Quest log shows Shadow accepted the novice ceremony. Subsequent alerts explicitly demand a meditation spot and practitioner role. Ceremony snapshots occur amid fires and resource shortages, adding stress without infrastructure to support the new role.
source: 11th–13th of Aprimay (Need meditation spot; Practitioner role unfilled)
unverified_claims: Exact throneroom size or quality requirements for novice title (not detailed in provided wiki facts)

title: Recurring fires during resource-critical periods
cause_chain: Fire! alerts on 10th, 11th, and 13th of Aprimay
Colonists divert to firefighting while Low food, Low medicine, and medical treatment needs are already active
No evidence of firefoam or proactive firebreaks
recommendation: Keep a few firefoam poppers or at least stone/brick walls around high-value or wooden structures once the first Fire! occurs; assign a high-priority firefighter during dry or high-activity periods.
rationale: Multiple Fire! snapshots force all three colonists into firefighting or watching, interrupting recovery from earlier injuries and food work. This compounds the existing Low food / Low medicine pressure.

title: Build defenses before the first raid to prevent early injuries
recommendation: Construct basic defenses (walls, doors, turrets) as soon as 'Need defenses' appears, before wealth draws a raid; do not wait until a colonist is injured.
rationale: The only urgent alert of the run was 'Enemy downed' on day 7, coinciding with Samuel's injury and the 'Medical treatment needed' alert. Defenses were flagged missing on day 5 and still absent on day 8.

title: Treat injuries immediately and keep a medicine buffer
recommendation: Assign a doctor to treat injured pawns immediately when 'Medical treatment needed' fires, and maintain a medicine buffer of roughly 25+ so treatment is never delayed.
rationale: Prompt treatment with medicine on hand (23 on day 7, 29 on day 8, 28 on day 9) returned Samuel to full health by day 9 with zero downings.

title: Add a meditation spot before mood collapses
recommendation: Build a meditation spot and monitor mood once the alert appears; low mood can drop toward break risk quickly even in a stable colony.
rationale: Day 12 shows the sharpest mood dip of the run (36-54%) coinciding with the meditation-spot alert; mood rebounded by day 13, making the alert a leading indicator.

title: Maintain cooked food reserves above roughly five days
recommendation: Keep a cooked-meal buffer above about five days and replenish packaged meals before expansion; raw berries are not a substitute for ready meals.
rationale: Food trended downward across the run while wealth and demands rose; ending at 2.5 days leaves little margin for a raid or crop failure.
